name: idx_cloud_print_receipt_open_check_lookup
idx_inventory_ledger_fifo_known_cost_recent
sql:
CREATE INDEX idx_inventory_ledger_fifo_known_cost_recent
  ON public.inventory_ledger
    (raw_material_id, branch_id, warehouse_id,
     created_at DESC NULLS LAST, id DESC)
  INCLUDE (unit_cost)
  WHERE quantity < 0
    AND COALESCE(unit_cost, 0) > 0
    AND COALESCE(batch_number, '') NOT LIKE 'OV-%';

name: idx_inventory_ledger_receipt_known_cost_recent
sql:
CREATE INDEX idx_inventory_ledger_receipt_known_cost_recent
  ON public.inventory_ledger
    (raw_material_id, branch_id, warehouse_id,
     created_at DESC NULLS LAST, id DESC)
  INCLUDE (unit_cost)
  WHERE quantity > 0
    AND COALESCE(unit_cost, 0) > 0
    AND (
      COALESCE(entry_type, '') = 'purchase'
      OR COALESCE(reference_type, '') IN ('purchase', 'purchase_receipt')
    );

name: idx_raw_batches_known_cost_recent
sql:
CREATE INDEX idx_raw_batches_known_cost_recent
  ON public.raw_material_batches
    (raw_material_id, branch_id, warehouse_id,
     created_at DESC NULLS LAST, id DESC)
  INCLUDE (unit_cost)
  WHERE COALESCE(unit_cost, 0) > 0
    AND COALESCE(source_type, '') NOT LIKE '%_oversold';

idx_inventory_ledger_kitchen_approved_receipt
sql: CREATE INDEX idx_inventory_ledger_kitchen_approved_receipt ON public.inventory_ledger (raw_material_id, branch_id, created_at DESC NULLS LAST) INCLUDE (reference_id, unit_cost, id) WHERE reference_type = 'purchase' AND entry_type = 'purchase' AND COALESCE(unit_cost, 0) > 0;
